## Summary
- Briefly describe the feature/change
- Why now?

## Validation
- [ ] Backend: `make lint-backend` / targeted
- [ ] Frontend: `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:unit`
- [ ] E2E: `npm run e2e` (if applicable)
- [ ] Docs: updated README/docs
- [ ] Preview: Pages link added (if site/frontend changed)
- [ ] Traces/artifacts updated if behavior changed

## Notes
- Risks, rollout, follow-ups
